proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the stabilizer G -> U is the base change of j by the diagonal (0235), so separatedness or quasi-separatedness of j descends to G (01KU); a section of a separated (quasi-separated) morphism is a closed immersion (quasi-compact) (01KT), giving (b) => (c); finally the diagonal of R over U x U is a base change of the identity section e: U -> G by the diagram lemma (02YH), and immersions and quasi-compactness are stable under base change (01JY, 01K5), giving (c) => (a) (source lines 4374-4400)
